why: The Parachute versions the docs serve at /docs/v/<version>/<page>.md (major.minor). `current` is the version the pages are written for. A version without `frozen` is served from today's pages with a line on top; `npm run docs:freeze -- <version>` keeps a copy of its pages before they move on.

versions.note: Written for 0.9. Parachute Cloud runs 0.8 today: where 0.8 differs (note tools and /api/notes instead of record tools and /api/records), the page says so.
